_comment: Generated by benchmark/references/sciml/harvest.jl. ANSWER-KEY-ADJACENT: contains the reference error values the sciml suite is graded near and the schemes it is compared against. Denied to the pipeline by pipeline-settings.json and matched by verifylib/leakage.py.

upstream_defects.mechanism: that function indexes the saved noise sol.W.W with the solution's save index; saveat desynchronises the two. One or two save points work, three do not, and calculate_error = false does not suppress it.
upstream_defects.relation_to_published_failure: same error shape as the four BoundsError cells of plan §1a.2 (an n-element vector indexed at n+1); see notebook_reproduction for whether those cells still fail
upstream_defects.what: saveat with >= 3 save points on an SDEProblem carrying an `analytic` raises BoundsError in SciMLBase.calculate_solution_errors! (rode_solutions.jl:221)
upstream_defects.consequence_here: no timeseries :l2 column; the terminal relative error that the suite gates on is unaffected
